audits.claim_text: Under the frozen contract-v1 model and 3200ms horizon, timed Explorer agrees with dense 1ms search on jointly completed new generated samples from the familiar 388-task corpus.
audits.scope: All 388 prespecified generation attempts on familiar dataset tasks; catalog-backed inputs and predicate-family GV model; 3200ms only; conditional comparison and unconditional outcomes reported separately.

run_selection.selection_rule: Include complete fresh-v4 attempt; five-case old-v3 development pilot is retained separately. No fresh-v4 row excluded or retried.

excluded_runs.rationale: Prespecified five-case old-candidate development smoke check, not a fresh-generation sample.
Historical model and outcome-visible development data, not current-contract fresh-generation evidence.

check_results.rationale: All 388 case IDs, generator sources, model/domain derivation and caps frozen before fresh generation; domains serialized before searches. Task corpus remains familiar.
Completed-pair agreement is separated from all-case coverage; refusals and incomplete results are retained. Dense search is a comparator, not independently established ground truth.
Both engines use identical serialized domains, horizon, start time and caps in separate sequential processes; transition ratios use paired completed equivalent cases.
Every selected ID occurs once in manifest and outcomes, including missing/failed generation, preparation refusal and resource failures.
Descriptive finite-corpus results only; familiar tasks, one generation sample per task, no task-independent test split or independent ground truth. No population accuracy confidence claim.
Source and model frozen. Shared interpreters, catalog, input inference and observation can share bugs; internal E1 evidence does not remove all common-mode failures.
Protocol, candidate and model manifest, complete outcomes, logs and source hashes retained; generation seed unspecified by existing helper.
Evaluation checked recorded source and candidate hashes before and after execution. This is local continuity, not sandbox isolation or external timestamp authentication.

This is self-review. Search traversal differs but semantic adapters and observation are shared; tasks were used in development. 308/329 valid generated scripts are identical to the same-task old-v3 script; fresh generation is weak code-level holdout evidence.

independence.evidence: Same agent prepares evaluation and audit; dense search uses separate traversal but shares production semantics.

limitations: repository digest continuity is not filesystem isolation
familiar tasks are not unseen-task heldout
search engines share adapters and observation; no independent ground truth labels
3.2 seconds is a bounded evaluation horizon, not a completeness bound
308/329 valid generated scripts match the old-v3 script exactly; only 21 differ. Do not present all fresh invocations as unseen code.
Peak RSS includes interpreter/preparation overhead; timeout RSS is missing, not zero.
Declared GV families are normative model domains, not measured deployed GV stores.
No formal proof or full-language accuracy established by benchmark agreement.

predecessor_failures.rationale: Initial protocol construction failed because __file__ was relative; fixed before any protocol/candidate freeze or search. Dependent missing-file commands produced no evaluation artifacts.
Historical v3 numbers are not carried forward after semantics/input repairs; this run uses current catalog-backed model and bounded scope.

audits.minimum_corrective_action: Use only bounded descriptive results; obtain task-independent samples and stronger independent semantic coverage before stronger generalization/accuracy claims.
